sentences.en: There is no room for a vacuum in a continuum.
sentences.zh: 连续体中没有真空的位置。

sentences.en: The maid was cleaning the room with the vacuum cleaner.
sentences.zh: 女仆正在用吸尘器打扫房间。

sentences.en: Sami was rolling the vacuum cleaner in front of him.
sentences.zh: 萨米推着吸尘器在前面走。
